TestRFAutoExpand::test_rf_expand.description: 3 DCs x 1 node (vnodes). CREATE KEYSPACE NTS with 'replication_factor':1 must expand to dc1/dc2/dc3=1; with 'replication_factor':1,'dc3':3 must expand others but keep dc3=3; ALTER with 'replication_factor':2 must not change existing per-DC RFs. Checks system_schema.keyspaces.replication. Guards scylla #4210 (CASSANDRA-14303) RF auto-expansion.

TestRFAutoExpand::test_rf_expand_on_swit.description: 3 DCs x 1 rack x 1 node (vnodes). SimpleStrategy RF=3 -> ALTER to NTS without options must expand to dc1/dc2/dc3=3; SimpleStrategy RF=3 -> ALTER NTS {'dc1':2} must not expand; then ALTER NTS {'replication_factor':3} expands only unspecified DCs (dc1=2,dc2=3,dc3=3); NTS {'dc1':1} + ALTER replication_factor:3 -> dc1=1,dc2=3,dc3=3. Guards scylla #4210 expansion on ALTER / strategy switch.
